title: Floating button
intro: The round button on the game page that opens this menu.
modeFadedHint: See-through until you point at it, open the menu or get an alert.
modeEdgeHint: Only a thin tab shows at the side of the screen. Point at it or tap it to slide the button out.
hideHint: Open the menu with the keyboard shortcut or the toolbar icon instead.
resetDone: The button is back in the bottom-right corner.
dragHint: Drag the button to move it. With the button focused, Shift and the arrow keys move it too.
shortcutHint: Opens and closes the menu on the game page, even when the button is hidden.
